rawContent: #BystandersWeLove at @Google have partnered with Tarana Burke  and released a video. Me Too Rising depicts the global movement that has been #MeToo. Check out the incredible video here: https://t.co/OT6mOfTGIT and read about its impact here: https://t.co/kNleLoqWEW.

@SMU is bringing the #MeToo movement to their campus by empowering their students to speak up and become active #bystanders in their community. Their program Not On My Campus aims to end the silence surrounding sexual assault. Read more here: https://t.co/g7kI4mQrjQ

In the @nytimes, David McGlynn writes about what it means to raise sons in the #MeToo era. He encourages parents to start with avoiding gender roles and encouraging empathy. Read the full article here: https://t.co/GP8ofIX5jv

“The conversation about sexual assault has been started.” Article in @PsychToday guides parents on how to build off the momentum of the #MeToo movement and start conversations with their teenagers. Check out the full article here: https://t.co/h1emJaukRl
